text: This solution, Strengthening Institutions and Empowering Localities Against Disasters and Climate Change in the Philippines (SHIELD Programme) addresses natural catastrophe through public private partnerships in Philippines between Department of the Interior and Local Government (DILG), Office of Civil Defense (OCD), Department of Science and Technology (DOST), United Nations Development Programme (UNDP), UN-Habitat, Philippine Business for Social Progress (PBSP), National Resilience Council (NRC), and Consortium of Bangsamoro Civil Society (CBCS). The program was implemented in 2022 and focuses on collaboration and raising awareness.
